why: An override must show itself and offer reset from one renderer so a page author cannot omit the cue, and every control needs one home, one slot and one kind renderer.
what: packages/basalt-ui/src/controls/{control-view,spec,renderers,use-committed-field}*. Created here; 2.x donors in src/controls (multi-select-filter, range-filter) are rewritten, not wrapped. Sibling: v3-ctl-4b-control-home owns ControlHome and filterSlot.
must_not_touch: CHANGELOG.md, MIGRATING.md, llms.txt, scripts/check-budgets/** except areas/surface.ts, other areas' migrations files
contract: Frozen: ARCHITECTURE.md, this domain's contract.ts, src/core/ports.ts. Need a change: factory signal, take the reversible default. Read concepts/controls-url-state.md sections 3, 5, 9, 10 and evidence/gap-global-local-control-scope.md section 3 (prototype API). src/core/ports.ts owns ControlHandle and ControlsSlot. Primitives come only as basalt-ui/ui/<name>; date-picker by dynamic import. Strings: useMessages, English defaults in your owned src/core/messages/controls.ts (qa-i2 seeds it).
exemplar: src/cards/stat-card*, src/ui/{card,badge}*, src/core/phase* (v3-exemplar-statcard; read in the tree).
change: ControlView (neutral Lozenge 'Local', title 'Overrides global: x', 'Use global' / 'Reset <label> to global', never colour alone); spec(handle,label,{options?,clearable?,placeholder?,facets?,as?}); one renderer per handle.kind with as hints; use-committed-field (debounce 200 ms, flush on Enter outside IME, blur, clear on mousedown). data-slots override-badge, override-reset. Keys controls.useGlobal, local, overridesGlobal. 2.x donors stay beside the new files. Rule: control-home (rung 5, body in ctl-8); the cue exists only here, so there is no rule for omitting it. Skill: generated docs/control-view.md. Tests: layout, axe, committed-field, type guards. A new public value symbol also lands, in this Issue, its raise in scripts/check-budgets/areas/surface.ts (the ceiling +1 and a `raises` row with from, to, consumer and repo) and its name in scripts/consumers.json (`<symbol>: <repo>:<path>`); make check refuses the symbol without them. The shard is scripts/export-surface/controls.json, written by `export-surface.mjs --update`.
commits: One PR, separate package and non-package commits (isolated-basalt-ui); conventional, empty scope, no attribution.
proof: Layout and axe tests under tests/layout/ on a fixture host (tests/layout/fixture/) at 1440, 768, 390, 320; screenshots of the fixture host taken by the layout test (1800x1200 and 390x844, dark and light, at most 3 rounds) and named in the PR body.
